name: research-integrity
description: Research integrity for Claude: checked citations and a verifiable ledger.

plugins.name: research-integrity
plugins.description: Quotes checked by code against the page they cite, and claims recorded only on checked quotes, in a hash-chained ledger anyone can verify.

plugins.name: research-compute
plugins.description: Optional add-on to research-integrity: compute nodes (this machine, SSH, Slurm) and instruments launched on them, every launch recorded in the research ledger before it starts.

plugins.name: research-formal
plugins.description: Optional add-on to research-integrity: a plan's understanding stated as a machine-checked Lean model, with a computed verdict of success or needed revision.
